title: How to Apply For D&O License

source.name: Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation, Tamil Nadu

text:
KEY LINES:
PROCESS TO APPLY NEW D&O LICENSE

FULL TEXT:
STEP 1 URL - https://tnurbanepay.tn.gov.in
STEP 2 SELECT : NEW USER REGISTRATION
PROCESS TO APPLY NEW D&O LICENSE
STEP 3
UNDER NEW REGISTRATION :
FILL THE USER DETAILS AND CLICK SUBMIT
STEP 4
AFTER SUBMITTING : ACTIVATION CODE WILL
BE SENT TO REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER
STEP 5
CLICK NEW USER ACTIVATION CODE IN
HOME PAGE
STEP 6
ENTER YOUR MOBILE NUMBER AND
ACTIVATION CODE
STEP 7
CLICK  SUBMIT , USER WILL BE
REGISTERED SUCCESSFULLY
STEP 8 LOGIN WITH YOUR USERID AND PASSWORD
STEP 9
IN CITIZEN WEB PORTAL
CLICK  SERVICE REQUEST  CREATE
STEP 10
SELECT
NAME OF ULB COIMBATORE CITY MUNICIPAL
CORPORATION
SERVICE CATOGERYTRADE LICENCE
SERVICE NAME  NEW TRADE LICENSE
REQUEST
STEP 11 FILL THE APPLICANT DETAILS
STEP 12 SELECTTRADE NAME BASED ON TRADE
STEP 12 CLICK  VIEW FOR TRADE RATE
STEP 13
BASED ON SELECTED TRADE UNIT VALUE
TEXT BOX WILL BE ENABLED FILL THE UNIT
VALUE
NOTE:
MANDATORY DOCUMENTS {Document Size (Max 1MB)}
 ADDRESS PROOF
 ID PROOF
 COPY OF SALE DEED/ LEASE DEED/ GIFT DEED
STEP 13
CHOOSE FILETO UPLOAD DOCUMENTS
THEN VERIFY ALL THE DETAILS AND
CLICKSUBMIT
 SUBMITTED APPLICANT REQUEST WILL BE
FORWARD TO CONCERNED WARD SI’s
